name: The Blue Human
source:
You will play as a new caretaker for an experiment subject in a certain laboratory.

Make friends with a blue person.

[From [url=https://mangopp.itch.io/the-blue-human]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在某个实验室里，你将扮演新来的照料员，负责照顾一名实验对象。

和一个蓝色的人交朋友吧。

［取自[url=https://mangopp.itch.io/the-blue-human]itch.io[/url]］
